title: What a good wall comp. What a surprising outcome. I have no idea what...
transcript: big brother spoilers ahead it's 2:30 in the morning the wall comp just ended if you don't wanna know who won skip before the feeds cut for the final time we had two people left on the board Kamu who looked pretty solid and Lala who looked like she was maybe struggling she had gone through like struggling and looking really solid kind of for most of the last half of the evening feeds cut they’re down for a very long time I was like writing an obituary for the season we’re gonna have Kamu again everything is bad everything is terrible and then we come back we come back and Lala has won head of household 58 year old Lala won one of the most physical if not the most physical challenge over 11 other people younger than her that is incredible this woman is a bodybuilder she's built but I don't think anyone almost anyone would have predicted this and I am so glad she proved all of us wrong said you're all dumb idiots I know what I'm doing and I'm up here and I got you and we are living I'm so happy we have an episode where we get to keep melody and drew and then we don't get a kamu hOH and finally finally someone not in the toolshed is in power a new dawn it's a new day it's a new life and Lala is running the house and I have no idea what she's going to do and I am so excited about it congrats Lala congrats big brother we are blessed season begins today
